description: Browse The Gazette's notice-category taxonomy — the category codes accepted by gazette_search_notices. Optionally filter by a search word. Categories span companies (insolvency, name changes, mergers), people (bankruptcy, deceased estates, honours), environment & infrastructure (planning, roads, property), state/royal/church notices, and money (pensions, coinage). Example: gazette_notice_categories({ search: "insolvency" })

search.description: Optional word to filter category names, e.g. "insolvency", "roads", "probate"

name: gazette_notice_categories
